metadata.domain: Developer Tooling — Software Supply Chain Security
bdd_focus_alignment: Happy path: scan Python repo and export CycloneDX JSON
Happy path: scan JS/TS repo and export SPDX JSON
CVSS severity classification: High, Medium, Low assigned per vulnerability
Remediation enrichment: at least one of (recommendation, advisory link) per vulnerability
VEX filtering: suppressed vulnerabilities not included in output
No live NVD API call at scan time
NVD sync: daily schedule and on-demand refresh
CI/CD gate: non-zero exit code on scan error

scenarios.name: Scan Python LLM project — detects High CVE in langchain — outputs CycloneDX JSON with remediation
scenarios.description: Scans TaskMatrix (LLM/Agent stack) with langchain==0.0.101. Expects Syft to discover all 8 dependencies (direct + transitive), Grype to match CVE-2023-34540 (CVSS 9.8 HIGH) on langchain, and the SBOM output to include a CycloneDX JSON document with remediation enrichment pointing to the minimum safe version.
bdd_focus: Happy path: scan Python repo and export CycloneDX JSON
assertions: SBOM output file exists and parses as valid CycloneDX 1.4 JSON
components array contains exactly 8 entries
vulnerabilities array contains CVE-2023-34540 mapped to langchain@0.0.101 with severity=High and cvss=9.8
remediation_enrichment contains fix_version for each CVE
all components have non-empty purl fields
exit code is 0
zero network calls to nvd.nist.gov during scan (cache-only assertion)

scenarios.name: Scan classic ML project — detects mixed severity CVEs — outputs SPDX JSON
scenarios.description: Scans handson-ml (classic ML/DS stack) with numpy==1.22.0, scipy==1.6.0, scikit-learn==0.24.1, Pillow==9.0.1, tensorflow==1.15.5, and joblib==0.14.1 (transitive). Expects Grype to match 5 CVEs spanning High (joblib, Pillow, tensorflow) and Medium (numpy, scipy) bands. Output is SPDX 2.3 JSON. Tests severity distribution and multi-band output.
bdd_focus: Happy path: scan repo and export SPDX JSON
assertions: SBOM output parses as valid SPDX 2.3 JSON with spdxVersion and dataLicense fields
packages array contains exactly 9 entries with SPDXID, name, versionInfo, externalRefs
joblib 0.14.1 is present in packages array with transitive comment
CVE-2022-21797 is mapped to joblib@0.14.1 in vulnerability output
severity distribution contains at least three High, at least two Medium
all vulnerable packages have both purl and CPE in externalRefs
exit code is 0

scenarios.name: Scan clean project — no CVEs — outputs SBOM with empty vulnerability list
scenarios.description: Scans clean-api, a minimal Python Flask web service with no known CVEs in any of its 4 dependencies. Grype should match zero vulnerabilities from the NVD cache. Output CycloneDX JSON must have an empty vulnerabilities array. Tests that the tool does not fabricate CVEs and exits cleanly.
bdd_focus: Happy path: scan Python repo and export CycloneDX JSON
CI/CD gate: exit 0 on clean scan
assertions: CycloneDX output is schema-valid
components array has exactly 4 entries
vulnerabilities array is empty ([])
remediation_enrichment object is empty ({})
exit code is 0
stdout contains no severity labels (High/Medium/Low)

scenarios.name: NVD cache refresh — on-demand sync downloads and stores new CVE records
scenarios.description: Invokes sbom-tool sync to refresh the local NVD cache on-demand. Simulates downloading 3 new CVE records and updating 1 existing record. Tests that the sync_log table is updated, records_added and records_updated are accurate, and the cache last_synced timestamp advances.
bdd_focus: NVD sync: on-demand refresh command populates local cache
assertions: sync_log table has a new row with source='on_demand'
new row has records_added=3, records_updated=1
vulnerabilities table row count increased from 8 to 11
CVE-2023-34540 fixed_version value is '0.0.300'
last_synced value in all new rows is current timestamp
exit code is 0

scenarios.name: Transitive dependency carries CVE — not the direct dep — tests transitive detection path
scenarios.description: Validates that when a transitive dependency (joblib==0.14.1, pulled in by scikit-learn==0.24.1) carries a HIGH CVE, the tool correctly surfaces it against the transitive dep's PURL rather than its parent. scikit-learn itself has no CVE. This tests the transitive dependency resolution and PURL-based matching path of the vulnerability engine.
assertions: joblib@0.14.1 appears in SBOM packages/components with purl='pkg:pypi/joblib@0.14.1'
CVE-2022-21797 is mapped to joblib@0.14.1, NOT to scikit-learn@0.24.1
scikit-learn@0.24.1 has zero vulnerability entries
SBOM comment or annotation on joblib entry notes 'TRANSITIVE — via scikit-learn'
remediation for CVE-2022-21797 recommends upgrading joblib to >= 1.2.0

scenarios.name: VEX-filtered vulnerability excluded from output
scenarios.description: A VEX statement declares CVE-2018-19787 (lxml XSS) as 'not_affected' for the TaskMatrix context because the codebase does not call the HTML cleaner module. After OpenVEX filtering, CVE-2018-19787 must NOT appear as an unfiltered vulnerability in the output — it should be suppressed or flagged as vex_filtered=true.
bdd_focus: VEX filtering: suppressed vulnerabilities not included in output (or flagged)

vex_statement.note: TaskMatrix does not invoke lxml.html.clean module

assertions: CVE-2018-19787 does not appear in the vulnerabilities array of CycloneDX output
If the tool includes a suppressed section, CVE-2018-19787 appears there with vex_status='not_affected'
Active vulnerability count is 2 (CVE-2023-34540, CVE-2023-32681)
Output is still schema-valid CycloneDX JSON

scenarios.name: NVD cache stale — scan warns but does not silently produce zero vulnerabilities
scenarios.description: The NVD cache last_synced timestamp is more than 7 days in the past. The tool should detect the stale cache condition and either emit a warning to stderr, use exit code 3, or annotate the SBOM metadata. It must NOT silently produce a zero-vulnerability SBOM for a project known to have CVEs.
bdd_focus: NVD cache stale or empty at scan time: system should warn or error, not silently produce zero vulnerabilities

option_a.stderr_message: WARNING: NVD cache is 8 days old (threshold: 7 days). Run 'sbom-tool sync' to refresh.

option_b.sbom_metadata_value: Cache is 8 days old — vulnerability results may be incomplete

assertions: Tool detects cache age > staleness threshold
Either exit code is non-zero OR SBOM metadata contains staleness warning
Tool does NOT silently produce a zero-vulnerability SBOM for TaskMatrix
Stale cache message references 'sbom-tool sync' command

scenarios.name: Dependency deduplication — Trivy and Syft both report same package — output contains it exactly once
scenarios.description: When running in dual-tool mode (Syft + Trivy cross-validation), both engines report numpy@1.22.0 in the handson-ml scan. The OSSToolAdapter deduplication layer must merge by PURL and ensure numpy@1.22.0 appears exactly once in the SBOM. Tests the dedup_key=purl logic in the adapter.
bdd_focus: Dependency deduplication: Trivy and Syft report same dependency — output contains it exactly once
assertions: numpy@1.22.0 appears exactly once in the output component list
scipy@1.6.0 appears exactly once in the output component list
No two entries share the same purl value
Total unique deps after dedup equals raw_dep_list unique PURLs

scenarios.name: CVSS boundary condition — score at exact boundary between severity bands
scenarios.description: Tests correct CVSS severity classification at the exact band boundaries: score=7.0 is High (not Medium), score=6.9 is Medium (not High), score=4.0 is Medium (not Low), score=3.9 is Low (not Medium). Verifies the CVSS v3.1 banding rules: High>=7.0, Medium 4.0–6.9, Low<4.0.
bdd_focus: CVSS threshold boundary: score at exact boundary between severity bands
assertions: score=7.0 classified as High
score=6.9 classified as Medium
score=4.0 classified as Medium
score=3.9 classified as Low
score=null classified as Unknown (not as Low or any severity band)
No off-by-one errors at band boundaries

scenarios.name: Unsupported repository language — graceful error with non-zero exit code
scenarios.description: User attempts to scan a Go repository (not Python or JS/TS). The tool should detect the unsupported language during dependency discovery, emit an informative error message to stderr, and exit with a non-zero code. It must NOT produce a partial or empty SBOM without an explicit error signal.
bdd_focus: CI/CD gate: non-zero exit code on scan error
Unsupported language repository scanned: graceful error, not silent empty output
assertions: Exit code is non-zero (1 or 2)
stderr contains message referencing unsupported language or ecosystem
stderr message references supported languages (Python, JS/TS or pypi/npm)
No SBOM output file is created at the specified output path
stdout does not contain any CycloneDX or SPDX JSON structure
